casual.instruct: Casual, fast-paced throwaway remark, conversational speech among gaming buddies.

fast_talk.instruct: Fast-talking, animated, persuasive con-artist cadence, rapid justification.

sudden_shock.instruct: Sudden explosive shock, fast high pitch, shouting in utter disbelief and alarm.

screaming_panic.instruct: Genuine loss of composure, sudden desperate shout, cracking with exasperation.

dry_sarcasm.instruct: Understated dry sarcasm, flat comedic cynicism, subtle mocking deadpan, not theatrical.

annoyance.instruct: Tired, disappointed annoyance, short exasperated tone, fed up with teammate.

laughing.instruct: Spontaneous bursting laughter before speaking, genuine chuckles, hilarious disbelief.

deadpan.instruct: Deadpan, completely flat matter-of-fact delivery, zero drama, totally calm.

whisper_disbelief.instruct: Soft breathy whisper of utter existential disbelief, stunned confusion.
